name: Hibernal-Brae
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by magnetic pole anomalies. Beyond tectonic rift valleys, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
